topic: The live Moon lab shows the same lunar phase simultaneously on the orbit diagram and in the telescope eyepiece, so a child can connect one position in space with one view from Earth on a single screen

provenance.composition: Deterministic AppKit render from social/source/render-one-moon-two-perspectives-pack.swift; native observatory illustrations plus real localhost Moon-lab screens captured with social/source/capture-local-app.swift, with no generated UI.
